verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs list categorisation and analysis of transaction data, with merchant detection and spending insights, as a platform capability. That covers the category and merchant parts of the story. However, the evidence is a single one-line overview claim with no API-level detail on what an enriched transaction actually returns. missing for 10: merchant logos, explicit cleaned/normalised merchant names, API reference documentation of enrichment fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.
